agent.problem: The question types become formulaic across the middle of the stop. Cards 6, 7, 9, 11, 12, 14 and 15 are seven consecutive choice cards alternating multiple choice, true or false, multiple choice, true or false, multiple choice, true or false, multiple choice.

rule.text: Which question type comes next, the order the types come in and where a blank falls are chosen naturally for each card. They never follow a pattern.
